purpose: First discriminating A-G experiment; frozen before pilot output. Pilots calibrate resources, not favorable method selection.

claims.validity: Asymptotic pointwise stationary law; no finite-n or uniform local-to-unity guarantee.
claims.precision: At 500 independent runs, coverage near .95 has Monte Carlo SE .0097. Report SE for every coverage.
claims.gaussian_max_precision: 4096 conditional Gaussian draws; Monte Carlo CDF SE near .95 is .0034, separate from statistical approximation.
claims.failure_accounting: All requested repetitions in denominator; numerical failures remain explicit failures.
claims.adverse: iid score SE, pointwise intervals used as whole-curve bands, weak normalization, near-unit persistence and invalid exclusion.
claims.decision: If whole-curve coverage is below .90 with MC upper 95% endpoint below .93, flag finite-sample inadequacy; do not quietly retune on final runs.
